text: The agent was extending signup email validation to normalize addresses (trimming, lower-casing, and collapsing Gmail dot/plus alias variants) so equivalent addresses are treated as the same account, then reused that normalization to build a duplicate-email-detection utility across a list of addresses. The transcript's claim that a "dotless-domain test" is still failing is a detail worth checking against the actual test suite rather than taken at face value, since the diff itself gives no direct evidence of that test.
